cns.text: Ervos Trax dines with his longtime business partner Marchesa at her mansion in Paliano and announces that he is going to have her killed, because his network is moving into the High City and she is his only obstacle. He walks her through why a direct attack or poisoning would fail and explains that he would corrupt a trusted lieutenant, and Marchesa names Pietro Lokosh before he does.

Coughing blood, Ervos reveals that he has poisoned himself because one of them would have to die, and Marchesa admits that she planned to have him killed in two nights and that she will now be blamed. Ervos dies slumped into his plate, and Marchesa leaves to summon her butler, who has already dug a hole for the body.
Afterward Tulando finds forged papers on his breakfast table framing him for embezzlement and dealings with Ervos Trax, and he resigns within the hour.
